instruction: Withdraw: 10x Wines, Air Staff, Mind/6xAir/6xEarth/All Water Runes, Glarials Pebble, Rope (17 Inventory Slots)

Kill a Fire Giant inside Baxtorian Falls (use water spells). Somebody will get Rune Scimitar on this kill. I hope that's you.
Minigame Teleport to Soul Wars. Leave portal to Edgeville
